fact_kernel.text: FRAS published a 22 September 2026 event update stating that Raliul Vâlcii runs 24-26 September and that the programme starts joi, 24 septembrie, with the Golești shakedown and ceremonial start at 19:00 in Centrul Civic Râmnicu Vâlcea.
The organizer's separate programme also labels 24 September as Thursday.

The organizer's traffic-restriction notice contains the inconsistent wording 'Miercuri, 24 septembrie'; 24 September 2026 is Thursday. The weekday label is therefore a source-page error, not an unresolved calendar date.

The organizer states that the Civic Centre/Romarta taxi station is restricted 18:00-20:00 on 24 September and lists central-road restrictions for 26 September, 07:00-22:00, including segments of Calea lui Traian, Știrbei Vodă, Căpitan Negoescu and Tudor Vladimirescu, with stated resident/access exceptions.

No current public IPJ/municipal road-closure order or other competent-authority notice independently confirming the street-by-street restriction package was located in this operator pass. Formal detours and any exceptions beyond those stated by the organizer remain unknown.

The independent FRAS programme resolves the date/weekday contradiction that caused the previous HOLD, but the detailed closures should remain explicitly attributed to the organizer unless the canonical newsroom obtains competent-authority corroboration. A transparent attributed service update may be publishable if the service-accuracy gate accepts that evidence level.
